title: Research Memory Sidecar is designed to be non-authoritative and non-blocking
claim: The approved-in-chat Sidecar design intends to preserve research memory without changing canonical Knowledge or Product runtime and without blocking Product/Knowledge execution; implementation is not yet accepted as complete.
maturity_note: Issue #513 records the approved-in-chat design and non-interference contract. PR #562 remains open and unmerged; D-021 is not in current main.
wording_ceiling: Say 'design approved in chat and implementation in progress'; do not say the full Sidecar architecture is already accepted on main or automatically ingests repository events.
